item.coloph: dang po ston pa gshen rab kyis mdzad/ de nas rim gyis stong rgyang / hris pa gyer med/ dmu yi gshen po dran pa nam mkha'/ dmu gshen bdag gis gter du sbas/ phyi rabs dar ba'i smon lam btab/ gsang ngo / dpon gsas khyung rgod rtsal gyis gter zhal phyes/ rim par brgyud pa'o//
